description: During a recent visit to Mitchell, I heard from Dr. Lucio Margallo, who served as a primary care provider in that community for over 46 years. He expressed his concern that we are facing a severe physician shortage in our state, making it difficult for hospitals to sustain consistent, high-quality services.This on-the-ground observation is backed by data. title: Protecting Rural Health Care Starts with Building South Dakota's Workforce
